title: ServerStorage
summary: Server-only container: nothing here replicates to clients. Safe home for secret logic, server-only modules, and prefabs you spawn into the world later.

details.heading: Visibility
details.body: Clients never receive ServerStorage's contents — not even names. LocalScripts cannot require modules from here (they don't exist client-side).

explanation.whatItIs: The server's private warehouse. Whatever you store here stays server-side forever unless you explicitly move it somewhere public.
explanation.whyItExists: Some things must never reach players: anti-cheat rules, spawn tables, unrevealed map sections, server modules.
whenToUse: Prefabs spawned at runtime (clone from here, parent to workspace)
Anything sensitive — loot tables, validation rules, admin systems
whenNotToUse: When clients need to require the module or use the object — that's ReplicatedStorage
For objects you want visible-but-not-simulated yet — consider workspace with disabled parts
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
ServerStorage ──(never replicates)──✗ clients
     │
     └─ Clone + reparent to workspace → THEN it enters the world
```
tips: Spawn pattern: keep the template in ServerStorage, `template:Clone()` into workspace when needed
Pair with ServerScriptService: scripts in SSS, data/modules in ServerStorage
commonMistakes: Requiring a ServerStorage module from a LocalScript — impossible, the module isn't on the client
Putting RemoteEvents here expecting clients to find them — clients literally can't see this service

examples.title: Prefab spawning from ServerStorage
examples.code:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local function spawnEnemy(name, position)
    local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not template then
        warn("No enemy template:", name)
        return
    end
    local enemy = template:Clone()
    enemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
    enemy.Parent = workspace   -- NOW it replicates and simulates
    return enemy
end
